title: KnowledgeDelegationRequest
description: The knowledge service asks the control plane to act for the person who sent userToken, through that person's own agent (on-behalf-of). A signed service call: the signature, its time window and the single-use nonce together refuse replays.

userToken.description: The person's Entra access token for Muistamo, as the knowledge service received it. Never stored or recorded.

instance.description: Which of the person's agents acts. Needed only when the person has more than one active agent.

nonce.description: 128 random bits, hex encoded. Each nonce is accepted once.
